code-runner.executorMap.java: cd "$workspaceRoot"; javac -d bin (Get-Item "$dir\*.java"); $pkg = (Select-String -Path "$fullFileName" -Pattern '^\s*package\s+([^;]+);').Matches.Groups[1].Value; if ($pkg) { java -cp "bin;$dir" "$pkg.$fileNameWithoutExt" } else { java -cp "bin;$dir" $fileNameWithoutExt }
